'hold' = clip là nguồn của một cú dừng hình: phải có một khoảnh khắc đứng yên, rõ nét, để engine dừng ở đó. Cảnh 'breath' không nằm ở đây: creature-motion làm offline. Luật DNA D9: trước beat 14 không clip nào được có củ mở, sáng lên hay phồng to.
suffix: Photorealistic wildlife documentary footage, telephoto lens, natural 24fps motion, one continuous shot with no cuts. Keep every creature's exact shape, colours and markings from the start frame for the whole clip. Ambient nature sound only, no music, no voice.

clips.motion: The pale yellow-green Bulbasaur lies flat and still in the brightest patch of sun in the clearing, eyes half closed. The bulb on its back swells slowly and settles again, one beat after its ribcage rises, never in time with it. A few blades of grass stir. Locked camera with a very slow push-in.

Late golden afternoon at the edge of a small pond. The pale Bulbasaur stands still with both front feet sunk in cool mud and slowly shifts its weight; mud creeps around its toes and small rings spread across the water from its feet. It never lowers its head to drink. Static camera at the animal's eye level.

Evening. Two Bulbasaur lean shoulder against shoulder in a shrinking patch of sunlight and shove each other slowly back and forth with their flanks, mouths closed, no biting. One gives way and walks out of frame. The tree shadow creeps across the grass.

Two Bulbasaur face each other in golden evening light. From under each bulb a thin green vine unfurls slowly; the two vine tips meet in mid-air, twine around each other for a few seconds, then gently let go and draw back. Calm and slow, no striking.

The pale Bulbasaur swings one vine over its own shoulder in a smooth arc and brushes a small caterpillar off the base of its bulb; the caterpillar drops into the grass and the vine curls back. Medium shot, static camera.

Under a fern canopy with broken, dappled sunlight, several blue-green Bulbasaur lie pressed flat and almost vanish into the drifting light and shadow. Only the pale one stays plainly visible. Fern fronds sway slightly and light patches drift; the animals stay nearly motionless. The last two seconds are almost completely still.

A large brown bird with a red crest and a long thin straight beak folds its wings and stoops steeply from the top of the frame toward a fern clump. Beneath the fern a small pale Bulbasaur presses itself flat. The bird's talons rake the fern tips, then it pulls up and away out of frame while the fronds thrash. Low wide angle; real-time speed, slowing down at the moment the bird passes.

Close on the bulb on the pale Bulbasaur's back. The bulb stays closed and keeps exactly the same shape. In two short bursts a fine pale powder puffs out from the narrow gaps between its leaf layers and spreads sideways into a low hanging haze. The animal stays pressed low. Static camera.

A beaten-earth yard at dusk. A Bulbasaur whips two vines forward fast; they crack down onto the hard ground and throw up streaks of dust. The vines stay stretched out on the ground, perfectly still, for the last two seconds. Any onlookers are only a dark blurred ring far in the background, no faces.

The pale Bulbasaur walks slowly across the clearing, each step heavy and deliberate. The bulb on its back sways with every step but keeps its shape; its vines hang thick and droop toward the grass. Side tracking shot.

Early morning light moves across the clearing. The pale Bulbasaur lies still with its head pointing the same way the whole time, while the bulb on its back tilts slowly toward the rising sun on the right. Shadows shorten. Locked camera; the clip ends on a still frame.

Night in a hollow ringed by ancient trees. Twelve Bulbasaur stand in a silent circle, still except for slow breathing; one pale animal among them. Moonlight; low mist drifts across the ground. Very slow push-in.

Light rain on the old Venusaur's great faded flower; drops run off the petals. In front of her, two Bulbasaur that were bristling at each other slowly relax and lie down a few steps apart. Rain mist; static camera.
